tweets.text: You'd need 10²³ qubits and the energy output of a Kardashev Type II civilization to quantum-mine Bitcoin. A new paper just made the Grover attack math concrete — and it's hilariously impractical. Sleep well, miners.

Nature just reopened the Majorana debate. Legg argues Microsoft's topological-gap evidence might be complex low-energy noise, not a clean gap. If he's right, those 2029 Shor-breaks-crypto timelines deserve a serious haircut.

One byte flip in BIP-360: the P2MR test vector changes c1 to fb. Tiny diff, big implications — every post-quantum wallet implementation building against the old vector just broke. PQ Bitcoin is still very much under construction.

American Bitcoin Corp just approved a 1-for-15 reverse split across ~6.85 trillion outstanding shares. That's not a typo — trillions. When your share count needs scientific notation, the reverse split is doing a lot of heavy lifting.
